en.v: The audience who attended the industrial exhibition all sang the praises of the family
alarm system promoted by this exhibitor.

examples.zh: 参与本次工业展览会的观众无不对这家参展商所推广的家庭自动报警系统赞不绝口。

errata.original: Audience who attended the industrial exhibition all sang the praises of the family automatic alarm system promoted by this exhibitor.
